Ember Cultist
Medium Humanoid, Neutral Evil
AC 13 Initiative +2 (12)
HP 27 (5d8 + 5)
Speed 30 ft.
STR 11 +0 +0
DEX 14 +2 +2
CON 12 +1 +1
INT 10 +0 +0
WIS 13 +1 +3
CHA 15 +2 +2
Skills Deception +4, Religion +2
Immunities Fire; Frightened
Senses Passive Perception 11
Languages Common, Ignan
CR 1 (XP 200; PB +2)
Traits
Fire Blessing. The cultist has Advantage on saving throws against being Frightened.
Actions
Multiattack. The cultist makes two Flame Blade attacks.
Flame Blade. Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) Fire damage.
Fire Bolt. Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 120 ft. Hit: 7 (2d6) Fire damage.
Bonus Actions
Ember Step. The cultist teleports up to 15 ft. to an unoccupied space it can see.
